title: GovernorTelemetry
description: The canonical governance visibility contract. Emitted by the Governor on a time-series cadence, providing a historical record of governance decisions, throttle events, and cohort transitions. Distinct from ObservatoryState (which is a point-in-time snapshot): GovernorTelemetry is a time-series stream of governance events. The UI must subscribe to this stream and render it without interpretation.

telemetry_id.description: Unique identifier for this telemetry record.

emitted_at_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp at which the Governor emitted this telemetry record.

anchor_sequence_id.description: The AuthoritativeEvent sequence_id that triggered or is associated with this telemetry record. Anchors governance decisions to the chronology.

event_class.description: Canonical governance event classifier. Exhaustive enumeration — no client-side governance event types are valid.

governor_id.description: Identifier of the Governor instance that emitted this record.

severity.description: Optional. Governance severity classification. Backend-certified — UI must not reclassify severity.

strategy_id.description: Optional. The strategy instance this telemetry record concerns. Required for STRATEGY_* event classes.

cohort_id.description: Optional. The cohort this telemetry record concerns. Required for COHORT_TRANSITION and STRATEGY_ADMITTED/EVICTED events.

payload.description: Event-class-specific telemetry payload. All fields are backend-certified. UI renders without transformation.

previous_state.description: State before the governance transition. Present for transition event classes.

next_state.description: State after the governance transition. Present for transition event classes.

reason.description: Human-readable governance decision rationale. Backend-emitted — UI renders verbatim.

metric_snapshot.description: Optional. Point-in-time metric values at the moment of the governance decision.

telemetry_signature.description: SHA-256 hex digest of (telemetry_id + anchor_sequence_id + event_class + governor_id). Enables Law One audit for all governance visibility surfaces.
